Subject: Marketplace listing questionnaire and billing annex for OmniCorp pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement has asked us to formalize the marketplace onboarding details so the pilot can proceed to procurement and legal review. Attached is OmniCorp's standard marketplace questionnaire and a short billing annex we use to validate invoicing and metering rules.

Ask: can you complete the questionnaire and return by end of day Thursday (2026-11-19)? Key areas procurement flagged:
- SKU/price mapping for marketplace listing
- Metering and billing cadence (monthly vs. usage invoice)
- Data residency / KMS controls for customer-managed keys
- Any marketplace-specific reseller terms we should be aware of

If it's easier, send the completed questionnaire plus any supporting diagrams (network, tenancy) and we can route to our vendor onboarding team.

Attachment: Omni_Marketplace_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Dave Miller
Senior Procurement Manager
OmniCorp Technologies
[dave.miller@omnicorp.com]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dave Miller <dave.miller@omnicorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing questionnaire and billing annex for OmniCorp pilot

Hi Dave,

Appreciate the clear list — we're on it. Attached are three items: the completed questionnaire (tabbed answers and cross-references), our billing annex tailored for OmniCorp notes, and a network segmentation diagram showing private VPC connectivity for marketplace consumption. Highlights below:

- SKU / pricing: we provide both a marketplace SKU (metered tokens per inference) and a "committed capacity" SKU for reserved GPU pools. See tab "SKU_mapping" in the attached workbook. We included recommended list/discount tiers for pilot and production.
- Metering & billing cadence: marketplaces typically invoice monthly based on metered usage; for OmniCorp we can support monthly metering with consolidated monthly invoices or direct monthly settlement via the marketplace. We also support invoiced billing for reserved capacity on net-30 terms as an exception (see Billing_Annex_OMNICORP.pdf).
- KMS & data residency: we support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS / HSM integrations) and can pin model inference processing to specific regions (us-west-2, us-east-1). Network diagram attached.
- Reseller terms: we have a short addendum for marketplace reseller attribution and revenue share; happy to share a clean redline if legal/procurement would like.

Next steps I propose: 1) confirm which metering SKU OmniCorp prefers for the pilot, 2) share any procurement-specific tax/VAT handling rules, and 3) confirm whether OmniCorp requires a dedicated VPC connector or if standard marketplace connectivity is sufficient for the pilot.

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Questionnaire_20261117.xlsx (xlsx); Billing_Annex_OMNICORP.pdf (pdf); Network_Segmentation_Diagram.png (png)

Thanks — I can hop on a short call if that helps.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0107

Ben — quick internal note (keeping this short so we don't delay):

- On SKU mapping, let's ensure we include a line item for "Reserved GPU Hour" (for dedicated pools) with a separate meter_id that marketplaces can use for forecasting. Procurement often asks for "forecastable" line items; that helps SRE/ops plan capacity.
- For the billing annex, add a clause for pro-rated credits on reserved capacity if OmniCorp scales down during the initial quarter.
- Karthik, can you confirm whether the KMS approach described (customer-managed key per account) requires any additional SOC/attestation beyond our standard SOC2 report? If yes, flag it and I'll coordinate with security.

If you want, I can draft the quick redline to procurement.

—Lauren
Director, GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@cloudmarketplace.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Dave Miller <dave.miller@omnicorp.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing questionnaire and billing annex for OmniCorp pilot

Hi Ben / Dave,

Thanks for the materials — Sara from Cloud Marketplace Ops. A few clarifying questions from our onboarding team before we kick the catalog review:

1) Tax/VAT handling: will Redwood expect the marketplace to collect tax on your behalf, or do you prefer to self-bill OmniCorp and remit taxes separately? (This affects how we configure the SKU metadata.)
2) Invoicing cadence: Cloud Marketplace supports monthly consolidated invoices. If Redwood wants net-30 direct invoices for reserved capacity, we need a signed billing annex and a primary AR contact.
3) KMS / Customer-managed keys: if you plan to surface an option for customer-managed keys in the marketplace UI, we require a short attestation describing the key lifecycle and whether Redwood retains any access.

If you can respond to the three bullets by EOD tomorrow, we can keep the pilot timeline intact and schedule a pre-listing call next week.

Best,
Sara Lopez
Partner Ops, Cloud Marketplace
[sara.lopez@cloudmarketplace.com]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@cloudmarketplace.com>, Dave Miller <dave.miller@omnicorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing questionnaire and billing annex for OmniCorp pilot

Sara / Dave —

Thanks — answers below and a few links so your ops/legal teams can validate quickly.

1) Tax/VAT: Redwood prefers the marketplace to collect and remit tax where supported. For markets where the marketplace cannot collect, we will self-bill based on the billing annex. Attached the annex which calls out tax handling per region.

2) Invoicing cadence: for metered marketplace usage, we will use monthly consolidated invoices via the marketplace. For reserved capacity (pilot committed pool) we are prepared to accept net-30 direct invoices; attached Billing_Annex_OMNICORP.pdf includes AR contact: ar@redwoodinference.com.

3) KMS attestation: we can provide a short attestation. Summary: customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM) are supported; Redwood does not persist key material and only uses ephemeral encryption contexts for runtime inference. We will supply a one-page attestation and relevant SOC2 excerpt.

Links/attachments for review:
- Billing_Annex_OMNICORP.pdf (attached)
- Completed questionnaire: Redwood_Onboarding_Questionnaire_20261117.xlsx (attached)
- Network diagram: Network_Segmentation_Diagram.png (attached)
- Onboarding console (read-only): https://app.redwoodinference.com/console/onboarding/DL-78921
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/DL-78921

Next step: I'll send a short attestation PDF by tomorrow afternoon and set up a 30-minute pre-listing call with Cloud Marketplace Ops (Sara) — suggested time: Thu 2026-11-19 10:00 PT. Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
